_comment: Display system for HRA structures that have no male (BodyParts3D) equivalent, by HRA organ. Read by pipeline/05-hra-to-manifest.mjs. `nodes` lists node-name fragments that identify the organ inside the united body. Every entry needs a reason. Vessels with no male equivalent take artery or vein from their Uberon is_a ancestors (see step 05), not from this table. `meshes` names individual GLB nodes that no ontology rule reaches.

epiploic-appendage-of-transverse-colon.reason: Fat appendage of the colon wall.

heart.reason: The heart and its chambers, valves and papillary muscles (cardiac display system).

intervertebral-disk.reason: Fibrocartilage of the vertebral column; male intervertebral disks are skeletal.

knee.reason: Joint model: bones, cartilage and ligaments; parts with a male equivalent take its system first.

mammary-gland.reason: Female breast tissue; grouped with reproductive structures, as female-only anatomy.

mouth.reason: Oral cavity and its contents; teeth and bones take their male equivalent system first.

pancreas.reason: Digestive and endocrine organ; digestive matches the male model.

pelvis.reason: Pelvic bones; soft parts with a male equivalent take its system first.

spleen.reason: Lymphoid organ; lymphatic matches the male model.

thymus.reason: Lymphoid organ; lymphatic matches the male model.

united-integumentary.reason: Skin and body-surface layers of the united female body.

united-nervous.reason: Brain, spinal cord and nerves (the eyes group above maps to sensory first).

united-muscular.reason: Muscles of the eye and knee, the only muscles in the female reference.

united-reproductive.reason: Female reproductive organs and their ligaments.

united-urinary.reason: Kidneys, ureters, bladder and their parts.

united-skeletal.reason: Bones of the female reference (partial skeleton).

united-lower-limb.reason: Knee joints: bones, cartilage and ligaments; muscles there map to muscular first.

VH_F_middle_hepatic_artery_branch_of_lef.reason: No crosswalk entry in HRA v2.5 (only the generic blood vasculature concept); named in the GLB as a hepatic artery branch.

VH_F_posterior_segmental_right_hepatic_a.reason: No crosswalk entry in HRA v2.5 (only the generic blood vasculature concept); named in the GLB as a hepatic artery segment.

VH_F_anterior_segmental_right_hepatic_ar.reason: No crosswalk entry in HRA v2.5 (only the generic blood vasculature concept); named in the GLB as a hepatic artery segment.

VH_F_right_branch_of_portal_vein.reason: No crosswalk entry in HRA v2.5 (only the generic blood vasculature concept); named in the GLB as a portal vein branch (the male portal vein is venous).

VH_F_left_branch_of_portal_vein.reason: No crosswalk entry in HRA v2.5 (only the generic blood vasculature concept); named in the GLB as a portal vein branch (the male portal vein is venous).
